unknown_activity_policy: Exclude activities without established semantics, including16/17; do not label as Nonfall.

existing_subject01.reason: User authorized using intact subject01 records before archive repair. This exception does not automatically apply to new archives.

split_rules: Assign entire subjects before generating any overlapping windows.
All single-action and continuous recordings of a subject inherit that subject's role.
Subject04 receives integrity checks but no model evaluation until all choices are frozen.
Check canonical CSI content duplicates and recognizable source recording overlap before accepting the split.
If a required subject is incomplete, stop and report; do not silently move subjects or create random window splits.

continuous_negative_policy.intended_source: Only training subjects' early continuous recordings.
continuous_negative_policy.requirement: The entire input window must end within the documented first120 seconds, using audited actual timestamps; check supplied fall annotation is outside this interval. Time-zero uncertainty remains disclosed.
continuous_negative_policy.difference_from_public_code: Public code labels windows by start time0..119. Requiring the entire window to remain within first120s is a conservative explicit deviation, not a claim of exact reproduction.

preprocessing.base: Existing Tx0 RF-scaled amplitude -> window-local Butterworth(8,0.2) filtfilt -> GCV over20 packets -> [1,400,90]
preprocessing.paper_standardization: Paper specifies per-subcarrier zero mean and unit standard deviation; the statistics population is not explicit and preprocess.ipynb is absent in inspected source.
preprocessing.candidate_standardization: An explicitly documented experimental variant: per-feature mean/std fitted on training features only, reused unchanged for validation/test/inference. Do not claim this is the missing official implementation.
preprocessing.existing_checkpoint_policy: Never attach new standardization to an existing checkpoint trained without it. Use a new run/checkpoint.

comparison_constraints.training_protocol_pending: Finalize common validation membership, class/record sampling and epoch budget after auditing counts, before observing validation model results. Keep class prior and optimization steps comparable across arms.
